answer: A farm cannot share one proof across a hundred names, so its costs multiply while its reward stays single. Each name is charged $68 per docket, and 70 dockets before the first reward is released, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. The desk only stamps a name that carries Silverbound locket keeper ruby charter, and the stamp itself rests on a charter locket keepers hold after jewel shop inspections. One anchor, one entry. The timber is checked, not assumed. The tally keeps beacon.
